findings.claim: The replica grant now publishes annotation `body` text even though the current Web-02 scope is case-summary publication and the browser-side mitigation only prevents persistent materialization, not authorization of the shape itself.
findings.evidence: The hunk adds `ProjectionId::Annotations` with columns including `"body"` and `scope: DefinitionScope::Practice("practice_id")`; acceptance criterion 1.2 is limited to registering the case summary lane/privacy/columns/tenant/revocation, while `web/src/shared/sync/storage-policy.ts` only throws when `materializerEnabled && policy.mode === PERSISTENT`.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not include `annotations.body` in the Web-02 replica grant unless this change's acceptance scope explicitly approves that publication; otherwise gate it behind the separate annotation approval path and add an authorization/negative test at the grant boundary.
